image_description: A close-up shot of a person's hands holding a teal disposable lighter and lighting the tip of a hand-rolled cigarette or joint. The lighter is active, producing a bright orange flame and significant sparks flying to the left. Smoke is visible rising from the lit end of the cigarette. The background is blurred, showing hints of greenery and clothing.
